what: The photo covering the screen is first visible only through the inner window of the large wordmark box (top 16.5% · right 51% · bottom 17% · left 16%), then while the next section’s top edge passes from 95%→30% of the screen, the cropped sides release on all four edges until it fills the screen (scrub, no curve)

options.inset: Inner window of the reference box (top right bottom left, %), default "16.5 51 17 16" — If there is no ref, it is measured from the media (photo) element’s own box (Brand center rectangle 25 25 25 25)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo that gets cropped then released (usually fixed · fills the screen)
options.[data-fx-part=ref]: (If present) reference element for measuring the window position (big wordmark) — if absent, the photo itself
options.[data-fx-part=trigger]: (If present) scroll-measuring container — if absent, the part’s own element
options.fade: When 1, the photo also resolves from transparent 0 → 1 while unblurring (brand), default 0
